One graceful original hummingbird sculpted from transparent celestial glass, wings lifted in a soft hovering curve, long fine clear beak and flowing tail, cobalt-blue and magenta nebula wisps suspended INSIDE its delicate body, tiny restrained star-like internal lights. Premium photoreal cosmic-glass fantasy sculpture, luminous pink/blue/violet/clear-glass palette with dark-night reflected shadows. No satellite, feather, quill, comet, aperture, circular frame, background starfield or writing. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.

Framing-only edit prompt: Framing correction only. Preserve the exact hummingbird design, transparent celestial glass, cobalt/magenta internal nebula, fine beak, flowing tail, pose and premium realistic sculpture style. Reframe the ENTIRE COMPLETE hummingbird smaller within a square1024x1024 transparent canvas, leaving a clearly empty20percent margin on all four sides. Do not crop any part of the bird.
